expanded_element.title: Can you put a smart lock on any door? - iLOQ
expanded_element.description: A simple answer to this question is, yes, you can pretty much put a smart lock on any kind of door ! Another question could be, how easy is it to put a smart lock on a door. That depends on the manufacturer and just how smart those smart locks are. Some smart locks require batteries, others need cables.
